item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 15/Nov/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will persist over southern China this week. Besides, a broad band of clouds will cover the region in the next couple of days. A replenishment of the monsoon is expected to bring slightly cooler weather to the coast of southern China early to midweek next week.

Date/Month: 16/11 (Wednesday)
Wind: East force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with one or two light rain patches.
Temp range: 22 - 25 C
R.H. range: 75 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low
